sentences.en: I suspect they water down the beer in that pub.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那家酒吧可能会兑水啤酒。

sentences.en: The police arrested a suspect in connection with the robbery.
sentences.zh: 警方逮捕了一名与抢劫案有关的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The police have found no trace of the suspect yet.
sentences.zh: 警方至今仍未找到这名嫌疑人的踪迹。
